how.title: How it's calculated
how.gross: Gross pay = all earnings and allowances.
how.insurance: Insurance = the insurable wage (the basic, or a fixed insurable wage), held between the minimum and maximum, times the employee's rate; the employer's share is a cost outside the net.
how.taxBase: Taxable pay = taxable items less items taken off before tax and (when set) the employee's insurance.
how.tax: Tax = the brackets applied to the taxable pay over the year (less the exemption), divided by 12 - or over the month.
how.levies: Other levies = their rate times their base.
how.net: Net = gross less the employee's deductions.
